OUR LITTLE STORY

A small place.
A warm welcome.

Little Ember began with a simple idea: every neighbourhood could use a place to slow down. Somewhere to catch up with a friend, turn a few pages, or just enjoy a cup made with care.

Our fictional café brings together familiar coffee, fresh bakes and an easygoing atmosphere. Pull up a chair. There is always room for one more.

Come say hello ↗
